findings.what: The tester's 05:21 retarget of two Services.Tests files was committed inside builder green ed44a60 (Agent: builder), not in its own commit, so no trailer separates the test change from the fix.
findings.why: requirements-trace, order and integrity: weakening is checked by comparing each test file at its red commit with HEAD, using the trailer log. activity.jsonl lines 430-434 show the edits were the tester's (agent af963aa8b), and the builder edited only src/ (lines 421-424). The packet has no red-commit copy of these files, so I could only judge them at HEAD. At HEAD the assertions are strong: literal Payment records, literal start and end dates, save, add and reference-call counts, the clock read once, plus new checks on the returned PolicyDetails (Same policy, current term 1, Active). The #25 signature change forced a joint commit, because the tester stub rule can't modify an existing signature. The commit message says so. Non-blocking, but the evidence trail is thinner than the loop requires.

notes: A1/R1 RESOLVED. PoliciesController.Renew (diff.patch 223-245) makes one service call and returns renewal.Value.ToResponse(). Nothing calls service.Get after it. PolicyService.Renew reads UkCalendar.Today once, uses that date for both policy.Renew and Details(policy, today), and returns Result<PolicyDetails>, as in signatures.md line 94 (PR #25). The test is Renewal_read_across_UK_midnight_is_checked_and_answered_on_one_UK_today. It sets FakeTimeProvider.AutoAdvanceAmount to 1h from 22:30Z on the end date, so a second read would fall on the next UK date. It asserts the 201 body and the GET in full (Active, currentTermNumber 1). gate.finding-red@8f174d9 shows it failed for the right reason (currentTermNumber 2, expected 1), and gate.green@ed44a60 shows it passing.

A1/R2 RESOLVED. The RENEW-3b violation in Policy.cs (diff.patch 326-331) now has no extensions, which matches api.md line 64 ('—'). The test Renewal_without_auto_renew_with_a_payment_method_is_rejected_with_no_extension_members checks the exact member set of the problem and of its single violation (ruleId, detail). It was red at 8f174d9 and is green at ed44a60.

A1/R3 RESOLVED. The test is renamed to Renewal_with_a_startDate_as_an_unknown_field_is_rejected_with_400. 8f174d9 is TDD: refactor, a name-only change: same body, same trait and the same $.startDate error key.
